title: Phase 3 Trial of Pembrolizumab Plus Chemotherapy in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
abstract: This study evaluates pembrolizumab with chemotherapy in patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer expressing PD-L1. Primary endpoint is overall survival. Note: The primary endpoint has been revised from progression-free survival to overall survival as of protocol amendment v3.0 dated 2026-07-15. Secondary endpoints now include patient-reported outcomes. Study status updated to active, not recruiting pending safety review.
